To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the formation of organisatory knowledge at modern enterprises is a complex and multi dimensional process, which is based on the exchange and sharing of knowledge among employees.

the emergence of organisational and collective knowledge is determined by the exchange and spread of information, knowledge, and experience among employees of an organization; the emergence of organisional knowledge and its collective nature are determined by internal communication; the emergence of knowledge at an organization depends on the type of internal communication strategy; the most effective strategy for knowledge sharing is the integrative knowledgeproducing internal communication strategy.
the formation of organisatorial knowledge is determined by the type of internal communications strategies used by enterprises.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the formation of organisatory knowledge at modern enterprises, the role of internal communications in its formation, and the peculiarities of the internal communication strategies of enterprises as the basis for knowledge formation.The research is based on the results of the author's previous studies (Kuznetsova, 2012; 2013).
